outOfScope: The inventory observer is experimental in 1.2.0; running the observer-owning service on one logical CPU with 250 ms polling is not supported.
@shieldaai/agent-map is published at 1.2.0 as experimental and is outside the 1.x compatibility promise.
The adapters' ApprovalQueue and RateLimiter keep their state in memory in one process; a restart drops pending approvals (nothing runs) and resets rate counts.
